{{Top|leg}}
'''Khan''',<ref name="gaw">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> also known as '''Izvoshra Khan''',<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] within the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military structure known as the [[Kolkpravis]]. At anyone time there was only ever eight Khans each of whom directly served the supreme Kaleesh military [[Commander/Legends|commander]] known as the [[Khagan]], collectively they were known as the [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]]. Each Khan's [[khanate]] consisted of several [[Brigade (Kolkpravis)|brigades]] each lead by a [[Baatar]] to whom the Khan's usually left most of the control of the army as they personally were too busy carrying out special missions for the Khagan.<ref name="gaw" />

Grievous almost lost his life in the [[Crash of the Martyr|event]] of his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Martyr]]'', and thought to have [[Death/Legends|killed]] every member of the Izvoshra. After Grievous joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] as their [[Military rank/Legends|military leader]], they were replaced with the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 series MagnaGuard]] [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]] to serve him as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> Grievous, however, never truly embraced them as Khans, since they couldn't assist him with military counsel and their loyalty wasn't freely given, but rather encoded into their [[Brain/Legends|brains]].<ref name="CSWE" />
